> Visanix Global is a B2B industrial materials supplier based in Paschim Vihar, New Delhi, India (PIN 110063).
> It operates two specialised divisions: Visanix Polymers (PTFE and engineering plastics) and Visanix Impex (microfiber and textile import).
> Contact: sahil@visanixglobal.com | +91 9667445766

---

## Visanix Polymers — PTFE & Engineering Plastics Division
URL: https://www.visanixglobal.com/polymers

Visanix Polymers is the polymer materials division of Visanix Global. It supplies PTFE (Polytetrafluoroethylene), fluoropolymers, engineering plastics, rubber products, and stainless steel to chemical plants, pharmaceutical manufacturers, industrial OEMs, traders, and retailers across India.

### Key Products
- PTFE Rod (extruded and moulded, 6mm–200mm diameter): https://www.visanixglobal.com/polymers/products/ptfe-rod
- PTFE Skived Sheet (0.5mm–6mm thick, widths up to 2mtr): https://www.visanixglobal.com/polymers/products/ptfe-sheet-skived
- PTFE Moulded Sheet (5mm–100mm thick): https://www.visanixglobal.com/polymers/products/ptfe-sheet-moulded
- PTFE Tube (extruded and moulded, full OD/ID range): https://www.visanixglobal.com/polymers/products/ptfe-tube
- PTFE Gasket (custom cut to drawing): https://www.visanixglobal.com/polymers/products/ptfe-gasket
- PTFE Bush, Ball, Ring, Gland, Tape: https://www.visanixglobal.com/polymers/products
- Cast Nylon Sheet and Rod (PA6): https://www.visanixglobal.com/polymers/engineering-plastics/cast-nylon-sheet
- PEEK Sheet (up to 250°C service): https://www.visanixglobal.com/polymers/engineering-plastics/peek-sheet
- Delrin / POM Sheet and Rod: https://www.visanixglobal.com/polymers/engineering-plastics/delrin-sheet
- PVC Sheet, PP Sheet, PU Sheet and Rod, Acrylic Rod: https://www.visanixglobal.com/polymers/engineering-plastics
- Stainless Steel (SS 304, 316, 316L, Duplex): https://www.visanixglobal.com/polymers/products

### PTFE Material Grades Supplied
Virgin PTFE, 15% Glass Filled, 25% Glass Filled, 25% Carbon Filled, Carbon + Graphite, 25% Graphite Filled.
Details: https://www.visanixglobal.com/polymers/products/ptfe-grades

### Industries Served
Pharmaceutical, Chemical Processing, Oil & Gas, Food Processing, Water Treatment, Industrial Manufacturing.
Details: https://www.visanixglobal.com/polymers/industries

### Location & SEO Pages
- PTFE Supplier Delhi: https://www.visanixglobal.com/polymers/ptfe-supplier-delhi
- PTFE Supplier Gurugram / Delhi NCR: https://www.visanixglobal.com/polymers/ptfe-supplier-gurugram

## Visanix Impex — Microfiber & Textile Import Division
URL: https://www.visanixglobal.com/impex

Visanix Impex is the textile import division of Visanix Global. It imports and supplies premium microfiber towels, coral-velvet towels, bath towels, baby towels, car cleaning towels, and kitchen towels to retailers, distributors, hotels, and hospitality businesses across India. Direct sourcing from verified manufacturers.

### Key Products
- Microfiber Coral-Velvet Face Towels (30×30cm, 40×60cm)
- Microfiber Bath Towels (56×112cm, 67×137cm, 70×140cm)
- Baby Hooded Towels and Baby Washcloths
- Car Cleaning / Detailing Microfiber Towels (30×40cm, 40×60cm)
- Cotton-Gauze Kitchen Towels
- Jacquard and Patterned Towels (custom OEM available)
Full catalogue: https://www.visanixglobal.com/impex/products

### About Visanix Impex
https://www.visanixglobal.com/impex/about

### Contact Visanix Impex
https://www.visanixglobal.com/impex/contact
